metadata.summary: Bounded neutral text records with explicit absence and normal stop/start persistence.

semantics.description: Put replaces one key; get returns found false and empty value only for observed absence, never failure. Maximum32 records. A completed put survives normal stop/start of the service with the same operator-owned data directory. No crash durability, transactions, backup, migration or hostile-code confinement guarantee. See SEMANTICS.md.
